name: people-input
title: People Input
description: Add people or teams as removable chips, searched as you type — a Combobox chips field over the host's async search, listing PersonOption rows with person and team avatars.

meta.whenToUse: Invite or add several people and teams at once from a directory search — a share dialog, adding members to a space or team.
meta.whenNotToUse: Pick one person (SearchableSelect with itemToAvatar), or type free-form tokens such as emails (ChipInput).
